title: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
description: Experts say the hack could leave agents vulnerable to scams, blackmail and targeted attacks.

title: Noah Woods left playground through gap in fence, inquest hears
description: Noah's mother tells parents to "hold their children a little tighter and cherish every moment".

title: Some BBC channels and radio stations may well have to close, director general says
description: The BBC's financial situation "may well mean" some channels and stations close, Matt Brittin says.

title: Daniel Thomas pleads not guilty after dinghy slashed
description: Daniel Thomas is accused of criminal damage after a video appeared to show him slashing at a dinghy.

title: NHS to suspend staff suspected of snooping on patient records
description: There have been too many cases of staff abusing patient trust, and enough is enough, the head of the NHS in England says.

title: Watch: Robbie Williams' surprise singalong after Peru gig cancelled
description: Robbie Williams gave an impromptu performance outside a hotel in Lima after his stadium concert was cancelled.

title: Met should probe handling of 'Putney Pusher' case, police watchdog says
description: Nicholas Brandram's family say he took his own life due to the "pressure" of a police investigation.

title: Jeffrey Donaldson victim describes 'profound impact' of child sex abuse
description: The former DUP leader was found guilty of 18 counts of child sex abuse, including one of rape, in June.

title: Jay-Z rape accuser says her allegation was false
description: A woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 now says she has never met the rap superstar.
